name: Linos of Melanthos
source:
Linos of Melanthos is a member of the inner circle of the Order of the Universal Panacea. He is the first member of the order to be introduced, and the father of Theodoros of Melanthos. He is one of the most proficient arcanists in the world when it comes to Transmutation, a specialty he shares with his son.

Linos is one of the few explicitly religious characters in the story, as both he and his son are members of the Postsideron Stoics.

[Edited from [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Linos_of_Melanthos]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
